placements.title: Automated ingestion and artifact persistence
placements.frame: How does the system intake, process, and persist incoming memory submissions without manual identifiers?

placements.title: Deriving slugs via LLM or deterministic fallback guarantees ingestion commit
placements.frame: How does the pipeline ensure reliable file commits when submissions lack an explicit identifier?
placements.why: Captures the operational requirement that absent explicit IDs, the pipeline must derive a slug through LLM generation or deterministic fallback and successfully commit the file.
